intro.heading: A Destination Unlike Anywhere Else on Earth
paragraphs: Towering waterfalls, active volcanoes, massive glaciers, black sand beaches, geothermal lagoons, and abundant wildlife combine to create one of the world's most extraordinary travel experiences.

A Scenic Iceland Cruise allows you to discover this remarkable island aboard the ultra-luxury Scenic Eclipse or Scenic Eclipse II. Unlike larger cruise ships, Scenic's Discovery Yachts provide an intimate, all-inclusive experience with personalized service, luxurious accommodations, and immersive excursions designed to bring you closer to Iceland's breathtaking natural beauty.
Whether you're exploring remote fjords, watching whales surface beside the ship, hiking volcanic landscapes, or visiting charming fishing villages, every day offers unforgettable discoveries.

items.name: Reykjavik
items.desc: Begin or end your journey in Iceland's vibrant capital, known for colorful architecture, excellent restaurants, museums, and geothermal culture.

items.name: Westfjords
items.desc: Discover dramatic cliffs, secluded villages, Dynjandi waterfall, and some of Iceland's least-visited landscapes.

items.name: Ísafjörður
items.desc: Explore one of Iceland's most picturesque fishing towns surrounded by towering mountains and pristine fjords.

items.name: Akureyri
items.desc: Known as the 'Capital of North Iceland,' offering botanical gardens, charming streets, and easy access to waterfalls and volcanic regions.

items.name: Seyðisfjörður
items.desc: Nestled within a spectacular fjord, this colorful village is famous for its artistic community and breathtaking scenery.

items.name: East Fjords

faqs.question: Where do Scenic Iceland Cruises sail?
faqs.answer: Scenic itineraries visit Reykjavik, Ísafjörður, Akureyri, Seyðisfjörður, the East Fjords, Westfjords, and other spectacular Icelandic destinations.

faqs.question: Which Scenic ships sail to Iceland?
faqs.answer: Scenic Eclipse and Scenic Eclipse II both operate luxury voyages to Iceland and the North Atlantic.

faqs.question: Are Scenic Iceland Cruises all-inclusive?
faqs.answer: Yes. Most voyages include luxury accommodations, butler service, premium dining, beverages, Wi-Fi, gratuities, and many shore excursions.

faqs.question: Is butler service included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every suite aboard Scenic Eclipse and Scenic Eclipse II includes personalized butler service.

faqs.question: What wildlife can I see in Iceland?
faqs.answer: Guests may see whales, puffins, seals, Arctic foxes, dolphins, seabirds, and numerous marine mammals depending on the season.

faqs.question: Are Zodiac excursions included?
faqs.answer: Many expedition activities, including Zodiac cruises, are included when conditions permit.

faqs.question: What is the best time to cruise Iceland?
faqs.answer: May through September offers excellent cruising conditions, with September also providing opportunities to see the Northern Lights on select voyages.

faqs.question: Is Scenic suitable for first-time expedition travelers?
faqs.answer: Yes. Scenic combines expedition experiences with six-star luxury, making it ideal for first-time luxury expedition cruisers.

faqs.question: Is Wi-Fi included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Complimentary Wi-Fi is included throughout most Scenic voyages.

faqs.question: Are gratuities included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Scenic includes onboard gratuities as part of its all-inclusive pricing.

faqs.question: How many guests sail aboard Scenic Eclipse?
faqs.answer: Scenic Eclipse and Scenic Eclipse II accommodate approximately 228 guests, creating an intimate and personalized experience.

faqs.question: Why choose Scenic for an Iceland cruise?
faqs.answer: Scenic combines luxury accommodations, personalized butler service, expert-led expeditions, immersive shore experiences, and all-inclusive amenities to create one of the most refined ways to explore Iceland.
